Every car has one expensive service. Book it with the price up front.

Somewhere between 60,000 and 100,000 miles, every car has the service interval that makes people wince: belts, fluids, plugs, sometimes a water pump while they are in there. It is not a covered failure. It is maintenance, and it is the one that shops love to quote after the car is on the lift.
Book it through Openbay+ and the price is posted first, with the member discount applied. Keep the receipt. The back half of your coverage term is when a claims adjuster is most likely to ask for maintenance records, and this is the record they ask about.
